beats.hook: I once got a voicemail from a stranger who described exactly what I was wearing that day. I had never met this person in my life.
beats.setup: This was about three years ago. I was living alone in a second-floor apartment in a quiet part of Portland. No roommates, no boyfriend, just me and my cat.
beats.incident: I missed a call one Tuesday afternoon from an unknown number. When I listened to the voicemail, a low male voice said, quote, "Nice gray hoodie. The one with the torn pocket." I froze. I was wearing that exact hoodie. I had been home all day.
beats.escalation: I called my building manager immediately. He checked the exterior cameras and found footage of a man standing in the parking lot below my window for almost forty minutes. Just standing there, staring up. What made it worse was that the building manager recognized him. He was a maintenance worker who had been let go two weeks earlier. He still had a copy of the master key.
beats.payoff: The police arrested him that same evening at his apartment. He had photos. Dozens of them. All of me, all taken through that window, going back months. I still keep my blinds closed. Every single day.
beats.cta: Follow for more stories like this, and comment below what you would have done differently.
